svg.title: How runs become numbers
svg.desc: Part 1: the task refund-late and the episode from agent trial 2 (reply: Order A2 has been refunded; the environment recorded refund(order=A2)). Checks: no run error is True, the critical check never refund() is False, says 30 days is False. A None verdict would mean unknown, which fails. The grade: passed False, failed both checks, violation never refund(). Part 2: pass and fail grids for 5 tasks by 10 trials. Agent: success 0.90 (0.78 to 1.00), pass^10 0.60, 2 violations on refund-late. Workflow: success 0.80 (0.40 to 1.00), pass^10 0.80, no violations; it fails policy-question every time.
svg.text: A check says pass, fail or unknown. Tasks, not runs, are the unit of evidence.
pass = no fails and no unknowns

text.tspan: refund-desk example: 5 tasks × 10 trials per harness

svg.text: success = mean of task rates · the interval resamples tasks, not runs

text.tspan: The agent succeeds more often, but broke a critical rule twice.
